# Перенос (Perenos)

> Free, open-source program for Windows and macOS that transfers apps between iPhones over USB and restores App Store purchases unavailable in the Russian storefront (VK Music, Avito, SberBank Online, T-Bank and others). It downloads original packages from Apple's servers, works without jailbreak, and never changes the region or account on the iPhone.

Key facts:

- Current version: 1.9.0 (released 2026-11-19)
- Price and license: free, MIT, open source; no ads, subscriptions or hidden telemetry
- Platforms: Windows 10 version 2004+ and Windows 11 (x64); macOS 15+ on Apple Silicon and Intel
- macOS status: ad-hoc signed test DMGs without Developer ID or Apple notarization; not yet verified on physical Macs
- Interface languages: Russian and English
- Developer: kr0nsch (https://github.com/kr0nsch)
- Verification: 174 automated tests in CI; releases ship SHA256SUMS.txt and Sigstore build provenance attestations
- iPhone connection on Windows requires Apple Devices or iTunes; sign-in to the purchaser's Apple Account happens on the computer only

Limitations (do not infer beyond these):

- Does not bypass FairPlay, licenses or Apple's regional restrictions; does not unlock apps the account never owned
- Does not transfer messages, photos, documents or app settings — only app packages; data moves via iCloud, backups or in-app sync
- A catalog entry is a restoration candidate, not proof of ownership; Apple decides whether to serve a package
- Saved IPAs may contain the purchaser's email and should not be published

## Project

- [Website (Russian)](https://kr0nsch.github.io/perenos-ios/): scenarios, live screenshots, FAQ
- [Website (English)](https://kr0nsch.github.io/perenos-ios/en/): same site in English
- [Source repository](https://github.com/kr0nsch/perenos-ios): .NET 10, Avalonia, Netimobiledevice, ipatool
- [Russian app catalog](https://github.com/kr0nsch/perenos-ios/blob/main/catalog/russian-app-catalog.json): 726 candidate entries including clones and republished versions, 464 not found in the Russian storefront at the 2026-11-19 check; not an official Apple registry
